title: Kevin Jennings unexpectedly got to stay home, QB now in final season at SMU as Heisman hopeful

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Kevin Jennings unexpectedly got to stay home, QB now in final season at SMU as Heisman hopeful
sources.description: Jennings is 19-7 as SMU’s starter, with his 7,709 yards and 55 touchdowns passing in reach of the school career records (9,081 yards, 72 TDs).
